name: digitalocean
description: Manage a DigitalOcean cloud account through the official do-mcp server — Droplets, App Platform, managed databases, Kubernetes (DOKS), networking, storage, billing, and more, all behind one MCP connection.

interface.shortDescription: Manage every DigitalOcean product via the official do-mcp server.
interface.longDescription: The DigitalOcean skill wraps do-mcp, the official DigitalOcean MCP server that proxies the v2 REST API as structured MCP tools. It exposes every product in a DigitalOcean account: Droplets (list, create, resize, snapshot, restore, power actions, backups, neighbors, kernels, upgrades), App Platform (apps, deployments, logs, specs, tiers, regions), managed databases (Postgres, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Kafka, OpenSearch) with backups, pools, replicas, users, firewall rules, trusted sources, online migration, and metrics, Kubernetes (DOKS) clusters and node pools, networking (VPCs, reserved IPs, floating IPs, firewalls, load balancers, CDN, DNS), storage (block volumes and snapshots, Spaces access keys, custom images, account-wide snapshots, snapshot policies), account/billing (balance, history, invoices, OAuth tokens, SSH keys, regions, sizes, tags, uptime checks, alerts). Authenticated via the DIGITALOCEAN_API_TOKEN environment variable. Spaces object operations are not proxied — use the S3-compatible Spaces API directly.
defaultPrompt: Use the DigitalOcean skill whenever the task involves managing Droplets, App Platform apps, managed databases, Kubernetes (DOKS) clusters, networking, storage, or billing in a DigitalOcean account.
Address resources by tag (`env:prod`, `role:web`) when possible — tag lookups survive renames, name lookups do not.
Never call any destructive endpoint (`droplet_delete`, `database_delete`, `cluster_delete`, etc.) without first showing the user the exact target ID/name and receiving an explicit confirmation.
